_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_pd#6, and a falsification of its Signal. The rule holds (the explicit PD step is CFL-bound) but you never see the NaN: raising TIMESTEP from 8e-6 to 1.6e-4 on upstream particle_sph_2d_pdbody_gravity.4C.yaml aborts after 8 steps with "a particle of phase 'pdphase' traveled more than one bin on this processor!" from particle/src/algorithm/4C_particle_algorithm.cpp line 790. The message names the phase, not the particle, prints no velocity and no step index, and never mentions time step, CFL or stability. There is no 'non-finite velocity at particle X' string and no NaN anywhere in the log, so grepping for either finds nothing. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: a particle of phase 'pdphase' traveled more than one bin on this processor!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: run the second arm at the upstream stable step. The bin-travel abort vanishes, the deck passes its own result tests and EXIT_TOOLARGE becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
